commit_scope: These commits identify production Zoom code; exact uncommitted comparator/helper and build input digests are embedded in each raw report and are committed with this evidence package.
package_version_note: Measurements were built before the release-only Cargo version bump and accurately report package_version0.6.0. The later coverage-overflow fixes reject malformed responses/cache input; they do not change valid response ranking or encoding.
baseline_capture_note: Only the included fixture-retention hook differs from the baseline comparator. Production baseline source is unchanged. Baseline and replay use byte-identical SQLite data, gold IDs, source inventory and registry revision.

reviewed_cases.source_review: separate AI engineering reviewer; not a human outcome study
reviewed_cases.holdout_status: development/regression cases after observed failures informed selector fixes

limits: Synthetic and exact-source capture adapters make no actual provider requests.
Compact-vs-legacy timings run in separate measurement blocks; only within-block arms alternate.
The controlled ablation shares graph construction and validation; it does not measure removing that infrastructure.
Three local debug timing repeats do not establish population p95 or general performance.
Gold retention is not semantic truth, upstream runtime verification, model productivity or human learning.
The old October9 baseline has different generated IDs and is preserved, not treated as this exact-registry comparison.
